steps.title: Consumers
steps.desc: dsh-agent-loop and dsh-compaction-basic call ctx.llm directly — no tool package sits between them and the service.

steps.title: Folded service
steps.desc: LlmRuntime folds Service Definition and Consumer into dsh-llm and claims ctx.llm; it owns the StreamChunk protocol.

steps.title: Route dispatch
steps.desc: The registry is a named-route dispatch table; deepseek-official and pi-ai's profile routes coexist without conflict.

steps.title: Hand-rolled wire
steps.desc: dsh-llm-deepseek speaks DeepSeek's exact SSE wire format via direct fetch, hand-translating reasoning_content.

steps.title: Wrapped SDK
steps.desc: dsh-llm-pi-ai wraps @earendil-works/pi-ai, inheriting its multi-provider reach; a new gateway is config, not code.
